principle_zh: 城市首先是生命系统，然后才是智能系统。
principle_en: A city is a living system before it is an intelligent system.

conditions.definition_zh: 通风、空气质量与植物交换
conditions.definition_en: Ventilation, air quality and vegetative exchange
Rain, infiltration, circulation and drinking water

conditions.definition_zh: 连续土壤、树根、微生物与非硬化地面
conditions.definition_en: Continuous soil, roots, microbes and unsealed ground

conditions.definition_zh: 树冠、遮阴、热环境与身体恢复
conditions.definition_en: Canopy, shade, thermal comfort and bodily recovery

conditions.definition_zh: 低照度、昼夜节律与夜间生境
conditions.definition_en: Low light, circadian rhythm and nocturnal habitat

conditions.definition_zh: 低噪声、停歇与非运营时段
conditions.definition_en: Low noise, rest and non-operating time

conditions.definition_zh: 植物、动物、昆虫与微生境

design_rule: Do not equate living ground with green ratio; retain soil, water, darkness, quiet, seasonality and habitat continuity.
